title: DNA Isolation & Quantification SOP
author: Justine C. Condon
materials: Wait for the measurement to complete.

steps.title: Prepare CD6 buffer
steps.instruction: Heat Solution CD6 to 60 °C in a dry‑bath, then pipette 110 µL per sample into a microcentrifuge tube (creates buffer).

steps.title: Label PowerBead tubes
steps.instruction: Label each PowerBead tube with the corresponding sample ID.

steps.title: Weigh and add sample
steps.instruction: Spin the PowerBead tube briefly to pull beads to the bottom, prepare the scale area (weighing paper, 10 mL beaker, place tube, tare), use a disposable spatula to place 0.25 g (250 mg) of sample into the tube, record the weight, and avoid cross‑contamination by cleaning spills and changing gloves as needed.

steps.title: Add CD1 and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of Solution CD1 to each filled PowerBead tube and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Vortex beads
steps.instruction: Secure the tube horizontally on a vortex adapter and vortex at max speed for 00:10:00; if more than 12 samples are processed simultaneously, increase vortex time by 5–10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge beads
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PowerBead tube at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (≈500–600 µL) to a labeled clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube; note that the supernatant may still contain some sample particles.

steps.title: Add CD2 and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Solution CD2 (store at 4 °C when not in use) and vortex for 5 seconds (00:00:05).

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute; avoid the pellet and transfer up to 700 µL of supernatant (≈500–600 µL) to a new labeled 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Add CD3 and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Solution CD3 and vortex for 5 seconds (00:00:05).

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the lysate onto a labeled MB Spin Column and centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Repeat lysate loading
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through and repeat the previous loading step to ensure all lysate passes through the MB Spin Column.

steps.title: Place column in collection tube
steps.instruction: Carefully place the MB Spin Column into a labeled clean 2 mL collection tube, avoiding splashes of flow‑through onto the column.

steps.title: Wash with Solution EA
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Solution EA to the column, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the same collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Solution C5
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Solution C5 to the column, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and place the column into a new labeled 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Final spin and elution prep
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 × g, °C, for 2 minutes, then place the MB Spin Column into a labeled 1.5 mL elution tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 60 °C Solution CD6 to the center of the white filter membrane, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, discard the column; the DNA is now ready for downstream applications.

steps.title: Optional transfer to Lo‑Bind
steps.instruction: Transfer all DNA to a labeled 0.5 mL Lo‑Bind tube, using the sample’s full name, include the date, write legibly, keep tubes in chronological order, and snap caps closed to prevent evaporation.

steps.title: Store or proceed
steps.instruction: Either store the DNA at –20 °C in a labeled box (stock DNA) for later aliquoting to working stock, or proceed to DNA quantification (step 24).

steps.title: Open Nanodrop application
steps.instruction: On the Nanodrop One System, select the Nucleic Acids application tab, then the dsDNA application, and follow the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Clean Nanodrop pedestals
steps.instruction: Lift the instrument arm and clean the upper and lower pedestals with a new laboratory wipe.

steps.title: Measure blank
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL of buffer solution (Solution CD6) onto the lower pedestal and lower the arm to measure a blank.

steps.title: Clean pedestals after blank
steps.instruction: Lift the arm and clean both pedestals with a new laboratory wipe.

steps.title: Prepare sample for measurement
steps.instruction: Keep DNA samples on ice or at 4 °C, and gently mix each sample briefly before measurement.

steps.title: Measure sample
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL of sample onto the lower pedestal, lower the arm, and record the concentration (ng/µL), A260/280 (acceptable ≥1.8–2.1), and A260/230 (≈2.0–2.2).

steps.title: Clean pedestals after sample
steps.instruction: Lift the arm and clean both pedestals with a new wipe.

steps.title: Repeat for all samples
steps.instruction: Repeat the preparation, measurement, and cleaning steps for each sample until all have been analyzed, then tap “End Experiment”.

steps.title: Final Nanodrop cleaning
steps.instruction: Lift the arm and clean both pedestals with a new laboratory wipe.
